text:
Sam: Quick sync — we're handing back the SOC2 sprint artifacts for KMS/HSM next week. I need owners confirmed for the remaining items so we can close the milestone:
- audit-log ingestion proof (parquet export + mapping)
- HSM attestation doc + witness screenshots
- key-rotation runbook + last-run logs
- terraform state snapshot for kms-prod

Priya: I can own audit-log ingestion proof. ETA EOD Friday. Need access to the staging log bucket and the sample ingestion pipeline config (where do we keep that?).

Javier: I will take HSM attestation doc. I've got a draft in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HsmDraft (internal only). Will add screenshots of console attestation and the HSM vendor cert chain.

Kelsey: For runbook and last-run logs I can do the runbook write-up but need Amir to pull the actual job logs from the rotation job. Also need the sha/hash of the rotation binary used in the last run to include in evidence.

Amir: I can pull logs. Quick command to get the job logs from staging cluster:
```
kubectl -n infra logs job/key-rotation-2026-03-12 --since=48h --tail=500
```
I'll export to the evidence bucket and drop the path in the folder.

Sam: Perfect. Priya — the ingestion config lives in infra/observability/kms-ingest (repo: infra-observe). You can reference PR #842 which contains the mapping. Also we need a small sample parquet export (no secrets) for the auditor — can you generate that and redact IDs?

Priya: Yep, I'll create the sample and link it. Also, do we have a canonical mapping file for token vs. plaintext fields? I saw two variants in the repo.

Javier: For the HSM cert chain we should include the key ceremony notes. I can add those once I sync with the vendor this afternoon. Any objections to including the vendor email thread as part of the evidence (redacted contact info)?

Kelsey: That's fine — redact PII. Auditor prefers the communication trail for attestation validation.

Sam: Two cross-team asks:
1) Eng-infra: can you review PR #842 and give an approval or minor comments by tomorrow so Priya can bundle it? (cc @Amir)
2) SecurityOps: we need the final list of artifacts the auditor will accept. Kelsey, do you have the checklist link?

Kelsey: Checklist is pinned in the compliance-drive at: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/compliance-checklist. I'll paste the minimal artifact list at the top of the evidence folder once we finalize owners.

deploy-bot: [automation] rotation-job/latest run status: SUCCESS — duration 4m12s — artifacts uploaded to gs://redwood-evidence/kms/rotation/2026-03-12/

Sam: Nice. Amir, can you drop the exact GS path here after export? Priya/Javier/Kelsey — can each ack ownership with a :thumbsup: if you can hit EOD Friday for your pieces? If anyone can't, reply with ETA.

Amir: Exported logs to gs://redwood-evidence/kms/rotation/2026-03-12/job-logs.json

Priya: :thumbsup: will add sample parquet + mapping link by Friday EOD.

Javier: :thumbsup: will add attestation doc + cert chain by Friday.

Kelsey: :thumbsup: will finalize runbook and artifact checklist by Friday noon.

Sam: Thanks — I'll update the milestone tracker and ping compliance reviewer once everything is in the evidence folder. If any blocker surfaces, drop it here. Also small FYI for reviewers: include the rotation job sha in the runbook header like `rotation_binary_sha: <sha256>` so auditors can correlate binary to logs.

Amir: noted and added the sha to the log export metadata.

Sam: OK closing this thread for now — will reopen if auditors ask follow-ups. :raised_hands:
